_note: The cloud puff where a robot bumps into an obstacle or the rim (src/render/bumpCloud.ts, design/themes.md). Sizes are in cells (times the board pitch), times in seconds, angles in degrees.
_lift: How far above the floor the cloud's anchor sits.
_toward_camera: How far the picture is pulled towards the camera, so it does not cut into the tiles.
_grow: How much the cloud swells while it plays (half of this is added to its size).
_rise: How far it drifts up while it plays.
_width: Width of the cloud picture on the board.
_aspect: Height over width of the cloud picture (assets/turnflock/fx/bump-cloud.webp).
_anchor: The point of the picture (0..1 from the left, 0..1 from the top) that sits on the bump.
_ball_size: Size of the balls the cloud breaks into, against the balls in the picture.
